title: New menu, ranked matches, Sunday tournaments and unlockable boards
notes: A brand-new menu on every page — Play Bots, Ranked, Tournament, Online Play and Training — with an app-style tab bar on phones.
Tap your profile (top right) to change your name and see your wins, ratings, boards and trophies.
⚔️ Ranked: 5 placement games, then climb Bronze → Silver → Gold → Platinum → Diamond → Master → Grandmaster with real clocks.
🏆 Sunday Cup: a 5-round, 32-player tournament every Sunday with live standings and trophies.
🎨 Unlock new boards by winning games — including the new Galaxy board and the Champion gold board for Sunday Cup winners.
